text:
maria: Heads up — ACME asked to prebook extra Dedicated GPU throughput for Q3; they want ~2x baseline for 3 months. We saw a usage spike this week and request came in today.
ajay: noted. do we have current committed headroom numbers for iad and ewr?
claire: iad pool: cap=420 TUs, committed=300, avg=330, peak=410 yesterday (short burst). ewr pool: cap=250, committed=200, avg=195. telemetry: queue tail latency spiked to 220ms on small batches during the peak.
ben: billing heads-up: prebooking will shift portion of usage to committed SKU on the invoice; line items will change. need finance to sign off on the commitment term.
maria: can someone run rough committed-impact calc? if we commit +150 TUs in iad for 3 months, what's monthly $ delta vs on-demand?
ajay: rough back-of-envelope: committed rate =~ $0.55/TU-hr, on-demand =~ $0.95/TU-hr. delta = $0.40 * 150 TUs = $60/hr => ~$43.2k/mo (720hr). this is a ballpark, finance will confirm actual contract math.
claire: ops note: we should avoid overcommitting and then wasting capacity. dedicated supports burst-to-shared with a cost premium; suggested strategy: prebook +100 TUs and enable burst fallback.
ben: finance note: there's a one-time conversion fee ~2% on committed purchases and potential tier discounts; also check invoicing cadence for short-term 3mo commits. will loop in @finance.
maria: infra question — can we provision +100 TUs in iad within 48h if approved? what's ETA and blockers?
ajay: provisioning path: create pool, attach nodegroup(s), run canary, compile runtime kernels if new instance types. ETA 36-48h if cloud quotas are available. need infra ticket + quota request.
claire: opening infra ticket now. including proposed rollout plan snippet:
```text
POOL: iad-dedicated-prebook-100
SIZE: +100 TUs
PURPOSE: ACME Q3 prebook
ROLLOUT: canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 2h
AUTOSCALE: min=50 desired=100 max=160
```
ben: tagging finance and legal for contract amendment. @sre-bot can you run pre-provision checks?
sre-bot: pre-provision-check: infra-alerts=none, quota-check: GPU quota in iad=320 available, placement-group capacity=ok, infra-ops window=next 72h.
maria: ok greenlight to move ahead with +100 TUs in iad with burst fallback. ben -> lead finance order, claire -> file ticket + schedule provisioning, ajay -> prepare automation PR for pool config. i'll brief AE.
ajay: starting automation PR: pool config + autoscale policy + canary steps. will add feature-flag gating.
claire: after provision, we should monitor queue depth, 95p tail latency, and token throughput for 48h. if 95p doesn't improve, consider +50 incremental.
ben: add expected monthly committed spend delta to the order notes: "~$43k/mo estimated saving vs on-demand for 150 TUs; ordering 100 TUs now — annotate conversion fee ~2% and possible tier discount."
maria: thanks all :thumbsup: will update ACME and sync with sales.
